rationale: The Court is likely to issue a narrow, text-focused opinion holding that PROMESA § 106(a) is forum-channeling and lacks the unmistakable language required to abrogate any sovereign immunity the Board may have. A Sotomayor dissent is the most likely separate writing, with some chance of a Thomas or Gorsuch concurrence emphasizing first-principles limits on inferring waivers from jurisdictional text.
